explanation: Array indices run from 0 to length-1, so `arr[arr.length]` reads one past the last valid element, returning `undefined` instead of the last item. It should be `arr[arr.length - 1]`.
choices: `arr[arr.length]` is out of bounds; it should be `arr[arr.length - 1]`
The function should use a for loop instead of direct indexing
The function is missing a null check on `arr`
